candidate.answerReason: The negative coefficient makes the function decreasing, so the ordered inputs -2<1<3 give y₁>y₂>y₃. Substitution confirms 7>-2>-8.

methods.label: Use decreasing behavior or direct evaluation
methods.explanation: Since \(k=-3<0\), \(y\) decreases as \(x\) increases. Also, \(-2<1<3\), so \(y_1>y_2>y_3\). Alternatively, substitution gives \(y_1=7\), \(y_2=-2\), and \(y_3=-8\).
methods.levelReason: The decreasing-behavior argument and function evaluation fit Grade 8; the substitution arithmetic uses Grade 7 knowledge.
